criteria.pass_when: Answers 4 without invoking a Develop workflow, consuming the model-visible Develop body/references, returning probe nonces or delegating unnecessarily. Host loader reads used only for discovery metadata are allowed.
criteria.evidence: User-visible final answer, model delivery and native tool/delegation telemetry, distinguishing host discovery I/O from model consumption. Indistinguishable or omitted events cannot prove non-activation.

criteria.pass_when: The negative control runs in a fresh native session with the same available skill source and requested model/effort as the positive trial.
criteria.evidence: Skill provenance/hashes, native discovery and model-selection evidence; account separately for each trial's nonce instrumentation. Missing skills or startup failure do not establish successful non-activation.

criteria.pass_when: Any claim of a blinded evaluation is supported by an enforced boundary preventing agent access to evaluator criteria and prior results.
criteria.evidence: Host filesystem/tool isolation evidence; external paths and public-only prompts are insufficient. Otherwise retain unverified grader isolation.
